results: 1. Comprehensive neuro-ophthalmic examination, including visual acuity, color vision, visual fields, ocular alignment, and ductions/versions in all directions
ocular motility examination: exotropia, hypotropia and motility impairment - a right oculomotor nerve palsy
cover test / ocular alignment: orthophoric
visual acuity and colour vision: normal
2. Formal pupillometry in bright and dark illumination, including assessment of the direct and consensual light responses and near response

pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
3. Apraclonidine 0.5% eye-drop test with pre- and post-test pupil and eyelid measurements
lid position and measurement (MRD1 both sides): not recorded

not performed / not available

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Chronic right oculomotor nerve palsy with aberrant parasympathetic regeneration causing episodic involuntary pupillary spasms (cyclic/spastic pupil), most likely idiopathic or congenital

ALTERNATIVE 1: Right Horner syndrome with an unrelated chronic right oculomotor nerve palsy

ALTERNATIVE 2: Right Adie tonic pupil with a coincidental chronic right oculomotor nerve palsy

ALTERNATIVE 3: Chronic restrictive or congenital right extraocular-muscle disorder mimicking an oculomotor nerve palsy
